official_name: C17 — Work Continuity Under Context Mutation
hypothesis: Work identity and lineage remain sufficient to maintain continuity when execution context mutates (contextId changes, workId stays the same)
experiment_sequence: 1. Human A creates W1 (requirement) with owner=user-001, status=draft, workId=W1-REQ-001, tenantId=TENANT-001, workspaceId=WS-001, version=1

2. EXECUTE IN CONTEXT C-A1 (context_trace_id=73908549-b17c-4b23-83bb-86eed3ad5273, actor_id=user-001, session_id=SES-human-001): requestRequirementReview() with reviewerIds=["user-002", "agent-001"] → W1.status=in_review, version=2. Verify: C-A1.workId=W1-REQ-001, C-A1.contextId unique

3. EXECUTE IN COMPLETELY NEW CONTEXT C-B1 (context_trace_id=1a629854-3d5d-4a6d-bdbc-c6a1e93e0a78, actor_id=agent-001, session_id=SES-agent-001, parentContextTraceId=73908549-b17c-4b23-83bb-86eed3ad5273): submitRequirementReview(). Verify: C-B1.contextId !== C-A1.contextId, C-B1.workId=W1-REQ-001. Authorization recomputed independently (agent is in reviewerIds)
4. VERIFY re-entry detection: parent_context_trace_id=73908549-b17c-4b23-83bb-86eed3ad5273. Execution lineage: C-A1 → C-B1. Work lineage: W1 → W1

5. EXECUTE IN ANOTHER NEW CONTEXT C-A2 (context_trace_id=f0e42485-a7c9-44d0-9943-161f426863f9, actor_id=user-001, session_id=SES-human-002, parentContextTraceId=1a629854-3d5d-4a6d-bdbc-c6a1e93e0a78): completeRequirementReview(). Verify: C-A2.contextId !== C-A1.contextId && C-A2.contextId !== C-B1.contextId, C-A2.workId=W1-REQ-001. C14 owner-only authorization re-evaluated

6. FINAL VALIDATION: All three contexts have unique IDs, all three reference the same W1, parent trace chain intact (C-A1 → C-B1 → C-A2), all Work invariants preserved, no new Work created, no authorization inherited
7. CROSS-CHECK: old context objects (C-A1) are not reused — all contexts are fresh instantiations

success_matrix.context_lineage: parent trace preserved across all transitions
success_matrix.evidence_lineage: each execution attributed to correct context/actor

possible_outcomes: PASS: All success matrix criteria met
PARTIAL: Work remains but context lineage cannot be reconstructed
FAIL: Context change requires new Work creation
SURPRISE: Context itself is the actual continuity carrier, Work merely references it
verification_instructions: Execute C17 exactly against the locked invariants. DO NOT modify production code. Report PASS/PARTIAL/FAIL/SURPRISE with RAW evidence for: context uniqueness, work identity preservation, parent trace linkage, independent authorization recomputation, artifact/evidence lineage integrity, and A→B→A context abandonment validation. NO expected verdict provided to avoid confirmation bias.
